verdict.rationale: Brex documents procurement approval flows, budget controls, and AI-powered invoice entry/approval/payments (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-15, brex-docs-6), plus a Payments API to send ACH/wires (brex-docs-12), implying an approvals-to-payment pipeline exists. However, there is no explicit documentation of configuring designated-teammate approval permissions or a one-click 'approve and send' payment action. Missing for 10: explicit docs on setting per-user approval permissions/roles, evidence of a one-click approve-and-send UI flow, and independent confirmation of this workflow in practice.
